Three directions drawn from your five references, plus the moves that apply whichever one wins.

A and B are opposites on purpose: Japanese asymmetry vs Versailles geometry. C is the least disruptive — it evolves the framing the page already has.

Pick a direction (or a hybrid) and I'll build it into the real page.
Worth noting: A's vermillion and B's plan-view diagram are not mutually exclusive. The strongest hybrid is probably A's palette and warmth with B's aerial plan for the five machines.
